turns.question: What share of the customers who signed up in September 2026 placed an order within 30 days of signing up?
turns.answer: 33.3% of the customers who signed up from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 placed an order within 30 days of signing up. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
